name: Patamon
main_effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Among them, add 1 card with the [DM] trait to the hand and place 1 card with the [Ver.3] trait face down as the bottom digivolution card of any of your Digimon with the [DM] trait . Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
source_effect: ＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing the top card of your security stack, prevent that deletion.)
